items.quote: And the LORD said unto Moses, Come up to me into the mount, and be there: and I will give thee tables of stone, and a law, and commandments which I have written; that thou mayest teach them.
items.claim: The text says the LORD called Moses up onto the mount and promised to give him tables of stone with a law and commandments the LORD had written, so that Moses could teach them. The document gives only the verse number 24:12. Naming it as Exodus 24:12 comes from model-prior and is not stated in the document.
items.action: summons Moses up the mount and promises to give him written tables of stone, a law, and commandments
items.object: tables of stone, a law, and commandments
items.mechanism: a written law passed to Moses so that he can teach it
